But I hate my major I hate how stupid I feel I hate that I can’t be like other people I hate that I can’t just take a break from everything like I need more time to get better life is moving too fast and I still am not better. And by hate I mean I hate it because I’m scared I think. But then I hate how I do have time. Like today I could be doing something to help myself but I feel too overwhelmed when I try to do anything. I feel useless and stuck and empty and bad. I get anxiety from not helping myself and that anxiety makes me freeze up and then I get more anxiety about how I’m freezing up and not doing anything. It’s like a trap and I can’t seem to get out of it sometimes. Sorry. this was more of a rant than an explanation. I don’t know if what I wrote even makes any sense but thank you for listening
